evidence.quote: We are adopting Zypherion for the analytics pipeline.

observations.why: The adoption is stated flatly and instrumentally, without hedging or audience-oriented flourish.
Native performance terminology and precise quantification make the register technical.
The timeline is delivered as a direct, operational commitment with no embellishment.
The labeled field and database vocabulary present a compact technical register.
The label, numerical multiplier, and columnar-query terminology are technical signals.
The labeled schedule and quarter notation use concise operational-technical formatting.
